title: Jegyet veszek egy filmre: Tickets for a Screening

sections.title: What the ticket is for
sections.content: You already know -ra/-re as "onto" a surface. Hungarian reuses the same suffix to say what event a ticket admits you to: jegyet veszek egy filmre ("I'm buying a ticket for a film"), jegy a hétórás vetítésre ("a ticket for the seven o'clock screening"). Nothing physical is being placed "onto" anything — this is an extended use of a case you already know.

sections.title: Ticket + -ra/-re
rows: a ticket for the seven o'clock screening

items.spanish: Két jegyet kérek a hétórás vetítésre.
items.english: I'd like two tickets for the seven o'clock screening.
I'm buying a ticket for this film.

sections.content: This same pattern extends to any event you buy a ticket for — a concert, a match, an exhibition — so once you have jegy valamire down, you can talk your way into almost anything.
